title: Generation · ODRÉ national register · region
description: Maximum installed capacity of the electricity generating installations listed in France's national register of production and storage installations (snapshot of 31 July 2026), summed by region and split by technology group, with storage capacity in a separate column. Only installations in operation on the snapshot date are counted. Each installation is counted in a region by the region code given in the register.

fields.name: unit_id
fields.description: Unit code of the boundaries release: ISO3-level-national code, e.g. USA-2-51059.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Unit name from the boundaries release; where it differs from the official geographic code, the official spelling is used (see verification.method).

fields.name: coverage_status
fields.description: covered: the unit is inside the area the source was processed for; not_covered: outside it, all values are empty (not zero).

fields.name: coverage_note
fields.description: Reason why the unit is not_covered, in English; empty for covered units.

null_meaning.not_covered: Not applicable: every not_covered unit has a reason in this field.
null_meaning.covered: The unit is covered, so there is no reason to give.

fields.name: installed_capacity_mw
fields.description: Sum of the maximum installed capacity (puissance maximale installée) of the operating generating installations in the region, storage excluded.

fields.name: storage_capacity_mw
fields.description: Maximum capacity of non-hydraulic storage installations, mostly batteries. It is not part of installed_capacity_mw. 0 means none are listed.

fields.name: capacity_nuclear_mw
fields.description: Part of installed_capacity_mw from nuclear installations. 0 means none are listed.

fields.name: capacity_fossil_mw
fields.description: Part of installed_capacity_mw from non-renewable thermal installations (gas, coal, oil). 0 means none are listed.

fields.name: capacity_hydro_mw
fields.description: Part of installed_capacity_mw from hydro installations, including pumped storage as the source classifies it. 0 means none are listed.

fields.name: capacity_wind_mw
fields.description: Part of installed_capacity_mw from wind installations. 0 means none are listed.

fields.name: capacity_solar_mw
fields.description: Part of installed_capacity_mw from solar installations. 0 means none are listed.

fields.name: capacity_bioenergy_mw
fields.description: Part of installed_capacity_mw from bioenergy installations. 0 means none are listed.

fields.name: capacity_other_mw
fields.description: Part of installed_capacity_mw from marine, geothermal and other installations. 0 means none are listed.

fields.name: n_installations
fields.description: Number of operating installations as counted in the source. Installations under 36 kW are aggregated in the source and counted here by the number it gives.

coverage.geography: All 18 regions, including the five overseas regions
known_gaps: Capacity is the maximum installed power declared in the register. It is not the net summer capacity of EIA-860, so the French and U.S. generation layers are not directly comparable.

Region values are taken from the region code in the register, not summed from departments. 36 aggregated rows (28.9 MW) have a region code but no department code; they are in the region values but in no department value, so these regions exceed the sum of their departments.

Installations without a commissioning date in the register (226 rows, 12.0 GW) are counted as operating. Disconnected installations (22 rows, 155.9 MW), installations commissioned after the snapshot date (6 rows, 1.0 MW) and installations temporarily withdrawn from service (6 rows, 1,007.4 MW) are not counted.

Rows without a region code (13 aggregated rows, 5.2 MW) and installations in Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon, Saint-Barthélemy and Saint-Martin (44 rows, 135.1 MW), which are not regions, are not in the region values.
The register is updated monthly; the layer is a snapshot of 31 July 2026.

verification.method: Operating installations are selected by script from the source table with the same rule as the department layer and summed by the region code of each row. A row counts as operating if it has no disconnection date, was commissioned on or before the snapshot date, and is not temporarily withdrawn. The region values plus the rows left out equal the register total, to the kilowatt. For each region, the difference from the sum of its departments equals its rows without a department code. No value was re-checked by a person or by an agent. The automated checks listed below were run on every build. 3 unit names corrected from Natural Earth spelling to the INSEE official geographic code.

automated_checks.description: SHA-256 of every input file was computed at the start and again at the end of the build; they match.
The file has exactly one row for each of the 18 FRA ADM1 units of the boundaries release; 18 are covered and 0 are not_covered with empty values.
Every unit_id of the layer exists in the boundaries release and no unit_id is repeated.
Columns of the CSV, GeoParquet and GeoJSON files equal fields[] in composition and order.
The sum of every numeric column read back from the published CSV equals the sum in the input table.

The source table was filtered by the stated rules and summed again by unit: 10 layer columns (installed_capacity_mw, storage_capacity_mw, capacity_nuclear_mw, capacity_fossil_mw, capacity_hydro_mw, capacity_wind_mw, capacity_solar_mw, capacity_bioenergy_mw, capacity_other_mw, n_installations) equal the recomputed sums in every covered unit; the source total equals the layer total plus the rows outside the units (codes 975, 977, 978 (not regions) 44 rows; rows without region code 13 rows).
